page.layout: One printed page, left, with the title centred at the top, then a two-column list of Scripture references with page numbers in a single column. At the lower right, the catchword "IN-". The right edge of the neighbouring page is visible at the scan edge and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The right-hand page is cut off at the scan edge and shows only fragments of a decorated initial and text columns; it is the neighbouring page and is left out. "Joh." and "Act." are read from abbreviated forms; "Act." is slightly doubtful.
